title: Vietnamese Pork Noodle Salad
description: A refreshing Vietnamese-inspired salad made with crispy pork, light and crunchy vegetables, and gluten-free noodles.
instructions: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pork and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pork to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the sliced cucumber and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the grated carrots and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, pork, cucumber mixture, and chopped cilantro.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice, soy sauce, and hoisin sauce.
Pour the dressing over the noodle mixture and toss to combine.
